summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited filed a Form 6-K with an August 24, 2026 press release announcing a strategic minority investment in Radisson Mining Resources Inc. through a non-brokered private placement of 53,420,000 units at C$1.07 per unit, totaling C$57,159,400. Each unit comprises one common share and half a warrant (strike C$1.39, five-year term). Post-closing, Agnico Eagle would own ~10.45% non-diluted and ~14.90% partially diluted. An investor rights agreement grants board nomination and participation rights, subject to ownership thresholds. The investment is a non-control equity stake, not a full acquisition, tender, or capital-return event, though it carries strategic/activist overtones. Watch for TSX-V approval and closing around September 2, 2026, plus any subsequent stake-building.
